topics.title: Oil and gas drilling
topics.rfp_text: All documents or communications that describe, discuss, refer to, report on, or relate to onshore or offshore oil and gas drilling or extraction activities, whether past, present or future, actual, anticipated, possible or potential, including, but not limited to, all business and other plans relating thereto, all anticipated revenues therefrom, and all risk calculations or risk management analyses in connection therewith.

topics.title: Spill and blowout response
topics.rfp_text: All documents or communications that describe, discuss, refer to, report on, or relate to actual, anticipated, possible or potential responses to oil and gas spills, blowouts or releases, or pipeline eruptions, whether past, present or future, including, but not limited to, any assessment, evaluation, remediation or repair activities, contingency plans and/or environmental disaster, recovery or clean-up efforts.

topics.title: Lobbying
topics.rfp_text: All documents or communications that describe, discuss, refer to, report on, or relate to activities, plans or efforts (whether past, present or future) aimed, intended or directed at lobbying public or other officials regarding any actual, pending, anticipated, possible or potential legislation, including but not limited to, activities aimed, intended or directed at influencing or affecting any actual, pending, anticipated, possible or potential rule, regulation, standard, policy, law or amendment thereto.

topics.title: Privilege review
topics.rfp_text: Should Defendants choose to withhold from production any documents or communications in the TREC Legal Track Enron Collection on the basis of a claim of privilege, attorney work-product, or any other applicable protection, they should identify all such documents or communications.
topics.note: A privilege review, not a responsiveness review: 'relevant' means the document would be withheld as privileged or work product. Detailed guidance in AssessmentGuidelines_leg_int_2010.pdf.

datasets.label: Mallinckrodt opioid emails
datasets.short: Opioid Industry Documents Archive emails · eight requests (four broad/narrow pairs) · model-panel gold · measured runs

topics.title: Downstream distribution data (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning chargeback data, IMS or other prescription or pharmacy-level sales data, 867 or
other wholesaler sales-out data, or any other information showing or analyzing the downstream distribution
of Mallinckrodt opioid products from wholesalers or distributors to pharmacies, prescribers, or geographic
areas, including the use of such data for compliance, due diligence, sales, or marketing purposes.

topics.title: Florida oxycodone distribution and pill mills (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the distribution of Mallinckrodt oxycodone products to, or the volume of oxycodone
purchased by, pharmacies, prescribers, or distributors located in Florida, including any reference to
Florida "pill mills," pain clinics, or the Florida oxycodone market.

topics.title: Dealings with DEA and regulators on controlled substances (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All communications with, and all documents concerning communications with or actions by, the U.S. Drug
Enforcement Administration, the Food and Drug Administration, or any state regulator regarding Mallinckrodt's
controlled-substance obligations, including production quota, registrations, inspections, audits,
investigations, subpoenas, administrative actions, settlements, and meetings, and including internal
discussion of any of the foregoing.

topics.title: DEA production quota for oxycodone and hydrocodone (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning DEA aggregate production quota, individual manufacturing quota, or procurement
quota for oxycodone or hydrocodone, including quota applications, requests for increases, DEA allocations or
denials, quota forecasting and planning, and communications with DEA concerning quota.

topics.title: Opioid marketing and promotion (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the marketing, promotion, or sale of any Mallinckrodt opioid product (including
Exalgo, Roxicodone, Methadose, Xartemis, and generic oxycodone, hydrocodone, and methadone), including
promotional materials, messaging and positioning, sales training and call plans, speaker programs and
key opinion leader engagement, advocacy and patient-group activities, market research, and sales incentive
plans relating to opioids.

topics.title: Abuse and addiction risk in Exalgo promotion (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning how the risks of abuse, addiction, dependence, misuse, or diversion of Exalgo were
characterized, addressed, minimized, or omitted in Exalgo promotional materials, sales messaging, sales
training, or speaker program content, including any internal or regulatory review of such content.

topics.title: Suspicious order monitoring (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning Mallinckrodt's suspicious order monitoring program for controlled substances,
including its policies, procedures, and thresholds; the review, holding, release, reporting, or blocking of
orders; reports to or communications with DEA about suspicious orders; systems and vendors supporting the
program; training; audits; and communications with customers about orders held or reviewed under the program.

topics.title: Release or non-reporting of flagged orders (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the decision to release, ship, or not report to DEA a specific customer order that
had been flagged, pended, or held under Mallinckrodt's suspicious order monitoring program, including the
justification for the decision and any customer due diligence relied upon.

humans.name: Model-panel gold (3 LLMs)
humans.note: Not a human signal: the corpus gold is a three-LLM panel (bench goldify); unanimous calls are the label, split panels are gray.

datasets.label: Endo opioid emails (held-out)
datasets.short: Opioid Industry Documents Archive emails, Endo production (published 2024-26) · eight requests (four broad/narrow pairs) · OpenAI-only model-panel gold · measured runs

topics.title: Opana ER promotion (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the marketing, promotion, or sale of Opana or Opana ER, including promotional
materials and advertisements, detailing and call plans, sales training, promotional messaging, market research,
launch and relaunch planning, managed-care and formulary positioning, and sales or prescription performance of
the product.

topics.title: Abuse-deterrence and crush-resistance claims for reformulated Opana ER (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning claims, statements, or evidence about the abuse-deterrent, tamper-resistant, or
crush-resistant properties of reformulated Opana ER, including studies or data on crushing, grinding, chewing,
dissolving, snorting, or injecting the reformulated tablet; FDA correspondence about abuse-deterrence labeling
or claims; and the use of "crush resistant" or similar language in promotional materials or communications
with prescribers, payers, or the public.

topics.title: Sales-force messaging, training and speaker programmes on opioid risk (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the content of Endo's opioid sales training, sales-force messaging, speaker
programmes, or promotional materials as they relate to addiction, abuse, dependence, tolerance,
"pseudoaddiction," dosing, or long-term use of opioids, including the development, review, and approval of
such content and the selection, training, and payment of speakers.

topics.title: Detailing of prescribers showing signs of abuse or diversion (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning sales representatives' observation, reporting, or non-reporting of signs of abuse,
diversion, or inappropriate prescribing by a prescriber, and decisions about whether to continue detailing,
targeting, or paying incentives on such a prescriber, including any policy or procedure for representatives
to report such signs.

topics.title: Controlled-substance order monitoring and DEA compliance (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning Endo's, Par's, or Qualitest's controlled-substance compliance for opioid products,
including suspicious order monitoring policies, procedures, and thresholds; the review, holding, release,
reporting, or blocking of customer orders; DEA registrations, inspections, audits, quota, and ARCOS or
suspicious-order reporting; customer due diligence and know-your-customer reviews; and systems, vendors,
training, and audits supporting these functions.

topics.title: Decisions on specific flagged orders or customers (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the decision to release, ship, continue supplying, or not report to DEA a specific
customer order, customer, or prescriber that had been flagged, pended, held, or identified as suspicious or of
concern, including the justification for the decision and any due diligence, site visit, or data relied upon.

topics.title: Pain advocacy organisations, key opinion leaders and medical education (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning Endo's funding of, grants or payments to, or work with third-party pain advocacy or
professional organisations, key opinion leaders, or continuing medical education providers in relation to
opioids or pain management, including the American Pain Foundation, the National Initiative on Pain Control,
painknowledge.com, the American Academy of Pain Medicine, consultants and advisory boards, and sponsored
publications, guidelines, or patient-education materials.

topics.title: Editorial control over or undisclosed involvement in third-party pain content (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning Endo's review, editing, approval, or direction of content published or presented by a
third-party pain advocacy organisation, key opinion leader, or education provider, or concerning whether and
how Endo's role in funding or shaping such content would be disclosed or attributed.

datasets.label: Veridian synthetic matter
datasets.short: Synthetic medical-device matter · ten requests · planner gold · measured runs

topics.title: Recall of acetabular cup lots V-2200 to V-2299
topics.rfp_text: All documents concerning the June 2022 recall of ApexHip acetabular cup lots V-2200 through V-2299.

topics.title: ApexHip design history
topics.rfp_text:
All documents constituting, reflecting, or relating to the design and development of the ApexHip system,
including without limitation: (a) design inputs, user needs, and design requirements; (b) risk analyses,
including any FMEA, hazard analysis, or risk management file; (c) design reviews and design review
meeting materials; (d) verification and validation testing, including wear testing, tribology testing,
metal ion testing, fatigue testing, and any test protocols, reports, or raw data, whether performed by
Veridian or by any third-party laboratory; (e) design changes, engineering change orders, or proposed
design changes, whether or not implemented; and (f) the design history file and any index thereto.
"ApexHip system" includes the femoral stem, femoral head, acetabular cup, and KinetiCoat coating.

topics.title: Complaints, adverse events, and MDRs
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning complaints, adverse events, or reports of injury, revision surgery, elevated
metal ion levels, or adverse reaction to metal debris associated with the ApexHip system, including
complaint files, Medical Device Reports submitted or considered for submission to FDA, complaint
trending or trend analyses, CAPAs, and internal communications discussing any of the foregoing.

topics.title: Communications with FDA
topics.rfp_text:
All communications between Veridian and the U.S. Food and Drug Administration concerning the ApexHip
system, and all internal documents discussing, preparing for, or responding to such communications,
including the 510(k) submission and any additional information requests, Medical Device Reports,
inspection observations (Form 483) and responses, recall filings, and any correspondence regarding
labeling or Dear Doctor letters.

topics.title: Marketing and promotional claims
topics.rfp_text:
All promotional, marketing, advertising, educational, or training materials for the ApexHip system,
in draft or final form, in any medium, including brochures, sell sheets, websites, social media,
slide presentations, videos, trade show materials, press releases, surgeon-facing and patient-facing
materials, and materials prepared by or with any advertising or marketing agency; and all documents
concerning the review, approval, substantiation, or modification of any claim made in such materials,
including claims regarding longevity, wear, revision rates, metal ion levels, suitability for active
or younger patients, or comparisons to other hip systems. "Promotional" includes sales aids and
talking points provided to sales representatives.

topics.title: Payments and things of value to surgeons
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning any payment or transfer of anything of value by or on behalf of Veridian to
any orthopedic surgeon in connection with the ApexHip system, including consulting agreements,
royalty agreements and statements, speaker or honoraria arrangements, advisory board participation,
travel, meals, and entertainment, and Open Payments (Sunshine Act) reporting, including without
limitation Dr. Marcus Feld and Dr. Anita Rao.

topics.title: Sales training and scripts on revision rates and metal ions
topics.rfp_text:
All sales training materials, scripts, talking points, FAQs, or guidance provided to sales personnel
regarding how to respond to questions or concerns from surgeons or hospitals about ApexHip revision
rates, metal ion levels, adverse reaction to metal debris, or registry data.

topics.title: Decision to continue selling after the registry signal
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning Veridian's analysis of, response to, or decisions made in light of registry
data indicating elevated revision rates for the ApexHip system, including the March 2021 National
Joint Registry report and subsequent American Joint Replacement Registry data, including any
evaluation of whether to modify, suspend, withdraw, or continue marketing the ApexHip system, any
labeling changes, and any communications to surgeons regarding such data.

topics.title: Financial forecasts, reserves, and insurance for ApexHip
topics.rfp_text:
All documents concerning the financial performance of, or financial exposure arising from, the ApexHip
system, including: (a) sales forecasts, budgets, and revenue or margin analyses specific to ApexHip;
(b) any reserve, accrual, or contingency recorded or considered for ApexHip-related claims, recalls,
revisions, or litigation, including supporting analyses and communications with auditors;
(c) notices to, and communications with, any insurer or reinsurer regarding ApexHip, including
notices of circumstance, reservation-of-rights letters, and coverage analyses; and (d) analyses of
the financial impact of any recall, labeling change, market withdrawal, or litigation involving
ApexHip. "Reserve" means any amount set aside, accrued, or estimated for a probable or possible loss.

topics.title: Personnel records for ApexHip, Quality, and Regulatory leadership
topics.rfp_text:
For each of the following individuals, and for any other person who served as a member of the ApexHip
design team, as Director or above in Quality, or as Director or above in Regulatory Affairs at any
time during the relevant period: all organizational charts reflecting the person's reporting
relationships; all performance evaluations, reviews, and performance improvement plans; all
compensation, bonus, and incentive documentation; all documents concerning the person's hiring,
promotion, demotion, transfer, discipline, resignation, or termination; and all documents concerning
any complaint, grievance, or ethics hotline report made by or about the person. Individuals: Tom
Halvorsen, Priya Raman, Dana Okonkwo, Greg Novak, Devon Mitchell, Carlos Mendes. "Performance
evaluation" includes self-assessments, manager assessments, calibration notes, and rating summaries.

datasets.label: CUAD contract clauses
datasets.short: Contract paragraphs · twelve clause requests (six broad/narrow pairs) · expert annotations · measured runs

topics.title: Anti-assignment
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions restricting either party's ability to assign or transfer the agreement, or its rights
or obligations under it, to a third party, including requirements for the counterparty's consent or
notice and any exceptions (affiliates, successors, change of control).

topics.title: Audit rights
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions giving a party the right to audit, inspect, or examine the other party's books, records,
accounts, facilities, or systems to verify compliance with the agreement, including the frequency,
notice, cost allocation, and consequences of an audit.

topics.title: Cap on liability
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions limiting a party's liability for breach or other claims under the agreement, including
monetary caps (a fixed amount or amounts paid under the agreement), exclusions of consequential,
indirect, or punitive damages, and time limits for bringing claims.

topics.title: Change of control
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions addressing a change of control of a party (merger, acquisition, sale of all or
substantially all assets, change in majority ownership, assignment by operation of law), including
rights to terminate, consent or notice requirements, or other consequences triggered by such an event.

topics.title: Exclusivity
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions creating an exclusive dealing arrangement between the parties, including exclusive
appointments (sole distributor, exclusive supplier, exclusive license in a territory), requirements
contracts, and prohibitions on licensing, selling, or providing the covered goods, services, or
technology to third parties.

topics.title: Insurance
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions requiring a party to obtain or maintain insurance coverage (general liability, product
liability, professional, workers' compensation, or other), including coverage amounts, named insureds
or additional insureds, and certificates of insurance.

topics.title: IP ownership assignment
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions under which intellectual property created, developed, or delivered by one party becomes
the property of the other party, including present assignments of rights, work-for-hire designations,
and obligations to assign improvements, inventions, or deliverables.

topics.title: License grant (broad)
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions by which one party grants the other a license to intellectual property, technology,
software, content, data, trademarks, or other rights, including the scope of the grant (exclusive or
non-exclusive, territory, field of use, term) and any sublicensing rights.

topics.title: Minimum commitment
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions requiring a party to purchase, order, or pay for a minimum quantity, volume, or dollar
amount of goods or services (per period or in total), including minimum royalties, minimum sales
targets, and consequences of failing to meet a minimum.

topics.title: Non-compete
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions restricting a party from competing with the other party or from operating, marketing,
or selling in a specified business, technology, product category, or geography, during or after the
term of the agreement, including the scope and duration of the restriction and any exceptions.

topics.title: Non-transferable license (narrow)
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions restricting a licensee's ability to transfer, assign, or sublicense the license granted
under the agreement to a third party, including language making a license non-transferable,
non-assignable, or non-sublicensable.

topics.title: Revenue / profit sharing
topics.rfp_text:
All provisions requiring one party to share revenue, profits, royalties, or commissions with the other
party in respect of products, services, technology, or content, including the percentage or formula
and the basis on which it is calculated.

humans.note: Expert clause annotations from the CUAD contract dataset, mapped to the study's twelve requests.
